name: Essence Chain
body:
Minimum Spell Level: 4th.

When you hit a target with your energy blast, you can use a free action to arc the blast to another creature within 60 feet of that target. You can arc the blast to a number of creatures equal to half the invocation’s spell level, and you can target the same creature more than once, so long as you arc it to at least one other creature before targeting it again.
